messages:
Leah: Hey folks — I'm at the US consulate in Madrid and just realized I left my physical insurance card at home. I have a visa interview tomorrow and they need an official proof-of-coverage letter. Can benefits issue an expedited PDF w/ plan dates and covered dependents? cc @maria-peopleops

maria-peopleops: Hi Leah — we can help. Can you DM me your employee ID and the dependent names? Also confirm which plan (e.g., Redwood Standard Plus) and whether you need it notarized or signed by benefits. Typical turnaround is 24–48 hrs but we can expedite.

Leah: Thanks! Employee ID 004321, plan: Redwood Standard Plus (company-sponsored). Dependents: Mateo Rivera (spouse). I need it signed and stamped if possible. The consulate accepts emailed PDFs. I can't log into the benefits portal — my phone number is blocked from receiving SMS 2FA while abroad.

maria-peopleops: Got it. I'll open an expedited case. One sec — attaching a draft we can send. If OK we'll generate official PDF and email to the consulate and cc you. Do you have the consulate contact email or should we put 'To Whom It May Concern'?

Leah: consulate-madrid@state.gov — thanks. 'To Whom It May Concern' is fine but a direct address helps. Can you include coverage effective date and plan tier, and list dependent as spouse with DOB 1990-06-12? Also include policy number 77-99321.

benefits-bot: Case BI-981234 created. Estimated SLA: 6 business hours for expedited letters. Document queue position: 2.

maria-peopleops: Draft ready — pasted below for quick review. If no edits we'll stamp and send to consulate and cc you.

maria-peopleops: ```
[Company Letterhead]
To: consulate-madrid@state.gov
Subject: Proof of Health Insurance Coverage for Visa Application

To Whom It May Concern,

This letter confirms that Leah (Employee ID 004321) is enrolled in Redwood Inference's Redwood Standard Plus health plan. Coverage effective date: 2022-07-01. Current status: Active.

Covered dependent: Mateo Rivera, spouse (DOB: 1990-06-12).
Policy number: 77-99321.

This letter is issued for the sole purpose of supporting Leah's visa application and is valid for 30 days from the date of issuance. If you require an officially signed and stamped copy, please advise and we will provide a PDF with benefits office signature.

Sincerely,
Maria Hernandez
People Operations — Benefits
Redwood Inference
Contact: benefits@redwood.ai
```

Leah: Looks good, please send. Thank you so much! :pray:

maria-peopleops: Sent to consulate-madrid@state.gov and cc'd you. Delivery queued. If they request notarization let us know — we can provide wording for local notary attestation.
